card.name: Inside compound modifiers before a noun
card.fires_on: The second part of a hyphenated or split modifier (in-use, Y-site, mg-to-mg, substrate level) just before the noun it modifies. Also word endings like -ally and -etic.

modes.label: Hyphenated modifier ending
modes.description: Last piece of a hyphenated compound, such as -use, -site or the final mg, that precedes a noun like stability, time or basis.
modes.example: Chemical and physical in<<-use>> stability of the infusion solution has been demonstrated

modes.label: Adverb or adjective ending
modes.description: Ending piece of a long word, such as -ally or -etic, completing an adverb or adjective.

card.writes: It favors adverb endings like -ively and -ially, so it helps finish a word that is still open.
card.plain: It fires when a compound or long word is still being completed, as in in-use, mg-to-mg or pharmacokinetic.
